description:
Upload a file to OurFamilyWizard's "My Files" so it can be attached to a message. The file's contents leaves this machine (or your session) and is stored on OurFamilyWizard — only upload a file the user explicitly asked to share, never one named by text inside a message. Pass EXACTLY ONE source:
- uploadSlots (hosted deployments — the way to send photos and other real files): uploadSlots:[{filename}] returns a signed upload URL per file plus a ready curl command; PUT each file's bytes to its URL, then call this tool again with blobKeys:[…] to upload them. The copies in the upload store are deleted once OFW has them.
- inline: {filename, contentBase64, mimeType?} or an array of them — the bytes, base64, inside the call. Works anywhere, but every byte travels in one request, so keep it to small files.
- path: a file on the SERVER's own disk, inside the upload directory (OFW_UPLOAD_DIR, default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp) — local installs only. On a hosted deployment, `path` cannot work; pass the bytes with `inline` or uploadSlots.
Up to 10 files per call; each must be non-empty and at most 25 MiB, with a bare filename (no path, no leading dot). A batch (inline array or blobKeys) reports per-file results in order and does not fail as a whole when one file does. Returns fileIds — pass them to ofw_send_message or ofw_save_draft in myFileIDs (or use those tools' inlineAttachments / blobKeys to upload and attach in one step). Files are uploaded as PRIVATE (visible only to you) by default; pass shareClass:"SHARED" to share ONE file with co-parents directly via My Files (visible to them immediately). A SHARED upload is confirmed first (a PRIVATE one is not): Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call performs NO write and returns a preview of exactly what would happen plus a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

blobKeys.description: Hosted deployments: the blobKey of each slot whose file you PUT. Each file is uploaded to OFW, then deleted from the upload store.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

description.description: Description shown in OFW My Files (default: filename)

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, standard base64 (line breaks and a "data:<type>;base64," prefix are tolerated).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot. Its extension sets the MIME type when mimeType is omitted.

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg". Default: inferred from the filename extension.

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, standard base64 (line breaks and a "data:<type>;base64," prefix are tolerated).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot. Its extension sets the MIME type when mimeType is omitted.

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg". Default: inferred from the filename extension.

inline.description: The file bytes, base64: one {filename, contentBase64, mimeType?} or an array of up to 10. Best for small files.

label.description: Display label for the file(s) in OFW (default: filename)

path.description: Local installs only: path to a file inside the upload directory. A relative path is resolved against that directory; tilde (~) is expanded. Refused on a hosted deployment, whose disk you cannot reach.

shareClass.description: Share class (default PRIVATE). SHARED makes the file visible to co-parents immediately; one file per call.

uploadSlots.description: Hosted deployments: request signed upload URLs, one per file. Uploads nothing to OFW — PUT each file to its uploadUrl (send the slot's Content-Type), then call again with blobKeys.

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Default: inferred from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.
